quote: They can act not only as an alternative to antibiotics in the case of overcoming fungal and bacterial infections, but also show immunostimulating and immunomodulating effects
statement: 它们不仅可以作为克服真菌和细菌感染时抗生素的替代品，还显示出免疫刺激和免疫调节作用。
text_zh: 它们不仅可以作为克服真菌和细菌感染时抗生素的替代品，还显示出免疫刺激和免疫调节作用。
text_en: They can serve not only as alternatives to antibiotics when overcoming fungal and bacterial infections, but also show immunostimulatory and immunomodulatory effects.

quote:
The long-term action of probiotics introduced in
the feed substrate obviously not only contributed to
the stimulation of the autochthonous microflora of
fish, but also enhanced the biotransformation of xe-
nobiotics due to the broad enzymatic activity of bac-
teria.
statement: 长期将益生菌引入饲料基质不仅刺激了鱼类的自身菌群，还由于细菌广泛的酶活性增强了异生物质的生物转化。
text_zh: 长期将益生菌引入饲料基质不仅刺激了鱼类的自身菌群，还由于细菌广泛的酶活性增强了异生物质的生物转化。
text_en: Long-term introduction of probiotics into the feed matrix not only stimulated the fish's own microbiota but also enhanced the biotransformation of xenobiotics due to the broad enzymatic activity of bacteria.

quote:
It is known that both chronic and short-term ex-
posure to bisphenol A causes various disorders in the
body of animals, as evidenced by changes in indica-
tors that act as biomarkers of the functional state of
the liver, kidneys, gills, muscles, and formed blood
elements (Akram et. al., 2022; Afzal et. al., 2022; Dile
et.al., 2022; Akram et. al., 2021; Faheem et. al.,
2019).
statement: 已知双酚A的慢性和短期暴露都会导致动物体内出现各种紊乱，表现为作为肝脏、肾脏、鳃、肌肉和血细胞功能状态生物标志物的指标变化。
text_zh: 已知双酚A的慢性和短期暴露都会导致动物体内出现各种紊乱，表现为作为肝脏、肾脏、鳃、肌肉和血细胞功能状态生物标志物的指标变化。
text_en: It is known that both chronic and short-term exposure to bisphenol A cause various disorders in animals, manifested as changes in indicators serving as biomarkers of the functional status of the liver, kidneys, gills, muscles, and blood cells.
outcome: 器官功能与血液指标健康

quote:
On the
other hand, probiotics have significant synthetic and
immunomodulating /stimulating properties (Maldo-
nado Galdeano et al., 2019), which allows mobilizing
various links of the body's defenses.
statement: 另一方面，益生菌具有显著的合成和免疫调节/刺激特性，这允许调动身体防御机制的各个环节。
text_zh: 另一方面，益生菌具有显著的合成和免疫调节/刺激特性，这允许调动身体防御机制的各个环节。
text_en: On the other hand, probiotics have significant synthesis and immunomodulatory/stimulating properties, which allow mobilization of all stages of the body's defense mechanisms.

quote: A 96-hour exposure to bisphenol A at a concentration of 1.5 mg/l causes skin darkening, increased mucus secretion, unusual motor activity, the appearance of unusual erythrocyte morphotypes, a slight increase in the number of leukocytes, and a decrease in the phagocytic activity of Carassius gibelio Bloch.
statement: 在1.5毫克/升浓度下暴露于双酚A 96小时会导致银鲫皮肤变黑、粘液分泌增加、运动异常、出现异常红细胞形态、白细胞数量轻微增加以及吞噬活性降低。
text_zh: 在1.5毫克/升浓度下暴露于双酚A 96小时会导致银鲫皮肤变黑、粘液分泌增加、运动异常、出现异常红细胞形态、白细胞数量轻微增加以及吞噬活性降低。
text_en: Exposure to bisphenol A at a concentration of 1.5 mg/L for 96 hours caused skin darkening, increased mucus secretion, abnormal movement, appearance of abnormal red blood cell morphology, a slight increase in white blood cell count, and decreased phagocytic activity in gibel carp.

quote: Prophylactic introduction of probiotic cultures as part of the feed contributed to the correction of behavioral reactions and individual hematological indicators.
statement: 作为饲料一部分预防性引入益生菌培养物有助于纠正行为反应和个别血液学指标。
text_zh: 作为饲料一部分预防性引入益生菌培养物有助于纠正行为反应和个别血液学指标。
text_en: The preventive introduction of probiotic cultures as part of the feed helps correct behavioral responses and individual hematological indicators.

quote: Approximately 0.2 mL of ACD anticoagulant was drawn into a 1 mL sterile syringe, and an appropriate volume of blood was collected from the caudal vein of each experimental fish.
statement: 将约0.2毫升ACD抗凝剂吸入1毫升无菌注射器中，并从每条实验鱼的尾静脉采集适当体积的血液。
text_zh: 将约0.2毫升ACD抗凝剂吸入1毫升无菌注射器中，并从每条实验鱼的尾静脉采集适当体积的血液。
text_en: Approximately 0.2 mL of ACD anticoagulant was drawn into a 1 mL sterile syringe, and an appropriate volume of blood was collected from the caudal vein of each experimental fish.

quote: In the aquatic environment, BPA usually decomposes in 0.5-6 days, but due to continuous ingestion, many organisms, especially fish, are constantly exposed to this toxic substance (Bhandari et. al., 2015).
statement: 在水生环境中，BPA通常在0.5-6天内分解，但由于持续摄入，许多生物，特别是鱼类，不断暴露于这种有毒物质。
text_zh: 在水生环境中，BPA通常在0.5-6天内分解，但由于持续摄入，许多生物，特别是鱼类，不断暴露于这种有毒物质。
text_en: In aquatic environments, BPA typically degrades within 0.5-6 days, but due to continuous intake, many organisms, especially fish, are constantly exposed to this toxic substance.

quote: At the same time, the following are noted: disruption of the reproductive system, embryo development, larval and juvenile growth, obesity due to modulation of pathways involved in adipocyte differentiation and lipid accumulation (Sun et.al, 2019); damage to the nervous system and impaired motor functions due to penetration through the blood-brain barrier, induc
statement: 同时注意到：由于涉及脂肪细胞分化和脂质积累途径的调节，导致生殖系统、胚胎发育、幼体和仔鱼生长紊乱以及肥胖；由于穿透血脑屏障导致的神经系统损伤和运动功能障碍。
text_zh: 同时注意到：由于涉及脂肪细胞分化和脂质积累途径的调节，导致生殖系统、胚胎发育、幼体和仔鱼生长紊乱以及肥胖；由于穿透血脑屏障导致的神经系统损伤和运动功能障碍。
text_en: It was also noted that: due to the regulation of adipocyte differentiation and lipid accumulation pathways, it led to disorders in the reproductive system, embryonic development, growth of larvae and fry, as well as obesity; and neurological damage and motor dysfunction caused by crossing the blood-brain barrier.

quote: The results of the experiment proved the absence of reliable changes in the number of erythrocytes of all experimental groups, but allowed to ascertain the morphological changes of erythrocytes in the blood of fish exposed to BPA.
statement: 实验结果证实，所有实验组的红细胞数量没有可靠变化，但确定了暴露于双酚A的鱼类血液中红细胞的形态学变化。
text_zh: 实验结果证实，所有实验组的红细胞数量没有可靠变化，但确定了暴露于双酚A的鱼类血液中红细胞的形态学变化。
text_en: Experimental results confirmed that there was no reliable change in red blood cell count in all experimental groups, but morphological changes in red blood cells in the blood of fish exposed to bisphenol A were identified.
outcome: 血液指标（红细胞数量与形态）

quote: According to literature data (Sharma and Chadha, 2021), under the influence of toxic doses of bisphenol A for 24-96 hours, abnormalities were detected in the erythrocytes of C. punctatus, in particular, lysed cells, binucleated cells, cells with micronuclei, karyolyzed cells, erythrocytes with a dentate nucleus, fusion of cells.
statement: 根据文献数据，在有毒剂量的双酚A作用24-96小时后，检测到C. punctatus的红细胞异常，特别是裂解细胞、双核细胞、含微核细胞、核溶解细胞、带齿状核的红细胞以及细胞融合。
text_zh: 根据文献数据，在有毒剂量的双酚A作用24-96小时后，检测到C. punctatus的红细胞异常，特别是裂解细胞、双核细胞、含微核细胞、核溶解细胞、带齿状核的红细胞以及细胞融合。
text_en: According to literature data, erythrocyte abnormalities were detected in C. punctatus after exposure to toxic doses of bisphenol A for 24-96 hours, specifically schistocytes, binucleated cells, micronucleated cells, karyolytic cells, erythrocytes with serrated nuclei, and cell fusion.

quote: Probiotic-containing feed was created on the basis of Aller Bronze with a diameter of 3 mm, followed by the introduction of Lactobacillus casei ... in the amount of 1×1011 cfu/g and granulation of the modified feed
statement: 含有益生菌的饲料是在直径为3毫米的Aller Bronze基础上，加入1×10^11 cfu/g的干酪乳杆菌并造粒制成的。
text_zh: 含有益生菌的饲料是在直径为3毫米的Aller Bronze基础上，加入1×10^11 cfu/g的干酪乳杆菌并造粒制成的。
text_en: Probiotic feed was produced by adding Lactobacillus casei at 1×10^11 cfu/g to Aller Bronze with a diameter of 3 mm and pelleting.

quote: During the period of acclimatization and 28-day study of the preventive effect of probiotic feed, water in the aquariums was replaced daily by 3/4 of the volume.
statement: 在驯化期和28天益生菌饲料预防效果研究期间，水族箱中的水每天更换体积的3/4。
text_zh: 在驯化期和28天益生菌饲料预防效果研究期间，水族箱中的水每天更换体积的3/4。
text_en: During the acclimation period and the 28-day study on the preventive effect of probiotic feed, 3/4 of the water volume in the aquariums was replaced daily.

quote: After pretreatment of the live incision site, blood was collected with a Pasteur pipette from the tail vein (Lawrence et al., 2020).
statement: 在对活体切口部位进行预处理后，使用巴斯德吸管从尾静脉采集血液。
text_zh: 在对活体切口部位进行预处理后，使用巴斯德吸管从尾静脉采集血液。
text_en: After pre-treatment of the live incision site, blood was collected from the tail vein using a Pasteur pipette.

quote: The fish were stocked in seven 700-L tanks (49 fish per tank), with constantly aerated and filtered water, under 14:10 light-dark cycle, temperature of 18 °C, dissolved oxygen concentration 9.0 mg/L, pH = 7.6 to 7.7, water hardness 186 mg CaCO 3 /L.
statement: 鱼类被饲养在七个700升的水箱中（每箱49条），使用持续充气和过滤的水，处于14:10的光暗周期下，温度为18°C，溶解氧浓度为9.0 mg/L，pH值为7.6至7.7，水的硬度为186 mg CaCO3/L。
text_zh: 鱼类被饲养在七个700升的水箱中（每箱49条），使用持续充气和过滤的水，处于14:10的光暗周期下，温度为18°C，溶解氧浓度为9.0 mg/L，pH值为7.6至7.7，水的硬度为186 mg CaCO3/L。
text_en: Fish were reared in seven 700-liter tanks (49 fish per tank) using continuously aerated and filtered water, under a 14:10 light-dark cycle, at a temperature of 18°C, with dissolved oxygen concentration of 9.0 mg/L, pH of 7.6 to 7.7, and water hardness of 186 mg CaCO3/L.

quote: It is known that the toxic effect of bisphenol A on the body is associated with impaired functioning of many systems - endocrine, reproductive, nervous, etc.
statement: 已知双酚A对身体的毒性作用与许多系统（内分泌、生殖、神经等）的功能受损有关。
text_zh: 已知双酚A对身体的毒性作用与许多系统（内分泌、生殖、神经等）的功能受损有关。
text_en: It is known that the toxic effects of bisphenol A on the body are associated with impaired function of many systems (endocrine, reproductive, nervous, etc.).

quote: The effect of BPA on the growth, behavior, morphological characteristics of fish, its genotoxicity has been characterized (Afzal et.al., 2022; Frenzilli G. et.al., 2021).
statement: 双酚A对鱼类生长、行为、形态特征及其遗传毒性的影响已被表征。
text_zh: 双酚A对鱼类生长、行为、形态特征及其遗传毒性的影响已被表征。
text_en: The effects of bisphenol A on fish growth, behavior, morphological characteristics, and its genotoxicity have been characterized.
outcome: 生长、行为、形态及遗传毒性

quote: Both long-term and short-term exposure to polutant causes changes in various tissues and organs such as liver, kidneys, gills, brain, etc. (Akram et al., 2022; Faheem et al., 2019; Huang et.al., 2018).
statement: 长期和短期接触污染物均会导致肝脏、肾脏、鳃、大脑等各种组织和器官发生变化。
text_zh: 长期和短期接触污染物均会导致肝脏、肾脏、鳃、大脑等各种组织和器官发生变化。
text_en: Both long-term and short-term exposure to pollutants cause changes in various tissues and organs, including the liver, kidneys, gills, and brain.

quote: During the acclimatization period, fish of both groups lost weight, which did not reach the initial values even after 32 days of feeding with traditional feed substrate.
statement: 在驯化期间，两组鱼均体重下降，即使在用传统饲料底物喂养32天后也未恢复到初始值。
text_zh: 在驯化期间，两组鱼均体重下降，即使在用传统饲料底物喂养32天后也未恢复到初始值。
text_en: During the acclimation period, both groups of fish lost weight and did not recover to their initial values even after being fed traditional feed substrate for 32 days.

quote:
Therefore, the aim of this work was to study the
influence of bisphenol A and the action of probiotics
introduced into the fodder substrate on individual
indicators of the body of Carassius gibelio Bloch.
statement: The study aims to investigate the influence of bisphenol A and probiotics introduced into the feed substrate on body indicators of Carassius gibelio Bloch.
text_en: The study aims to investigate the influence of bisphenol A and probiotics introduced into the feed substrate on body indicators of Carassius gibelio Bloch.

quote:
At the same time, the content of leukocytes was
determined,
the
qualitative
and
quantitative
composition of erythrocytes, indicators of phagocytic
activity were analyzed, general behavioral reactions
and changes in fish weight were evaluated.
statement: Leukocyte content, erythrocyte composition, phagocytic activity, behavioral reactions, and fish weight changes were evaluated.
text_en: Leukocyte content, erythrocyte composition, phagocytic activity, behavioral reactions, and fish weight changes were evaluated.

quote:
Experimental studies
were conducted on Carassius gibelio Bloch fish, the
initial weight of which, on average, was 60 g.  The
fish were transferred from the pools of the closed
water supply system to glass aquariums 40x27x40 cm
in size and left for acclimatization for 15 days.
statement: Fish were transferred from a closed water supply system to glass aquariums and acclimatized for 15 days.
text_en: Fish were transferred from a closed water supply system to glass aquariums and acclimatized for 15 days.

quote:
During
this time, the fish were on a standard feed ration (daily
in the amount of 1% of the total weight).
statement: During acclimatization, fish were fed a standard ration at 1% of total body weight daily.
text_en: During acclimatization, fish were fed a standard ration at 1% of total body weight daily.

quote:
Throughout
the experimental period, the following conditions
were observed: water temperature - 14 °C,
photoperiod - 16-hour, oxygen supply - appropriate
through the functioning of oxygenators.
statement: Water temperature was maintained at 14°C, photoperiod at 16 hours, and oxygen supply was ensured by oxygenators.
text_en: Water temperature was maintained at 14°C, photoperiod at 16 hours, and oxygen supply was ensured by oxygenators.

quote:
II - fish
that were on a standard food diet for 28 days and were
exposed to a toxic 96-hour exposure to bisphenol A,
concentration of 1.5 mg / l (group - bisphenol) at the
last stages of the experiment;
statement: Group II fish were exposed to 1.5 mg/l bisphenol A for 96 hours after 28 days on a standard diet.
text_en: Group II fish were exposed to 1.5 mg/l bisphenol A for 96 hours after 28 days on a standard diet.

III - fish that received
probiotic cultures as part of the feed substrate for 28
days and were further exposed to 96-hour exposure to
bisphenol (probiotics + bisphenol).

text_en: Group III fish received probiotic cultures in the feed for 28 days and were then exposed to bisphenol for 96 hours.

quote: In contrast, the fish exposed to cadmium with additional administration of melatonin had a lower accumulation of this metal.
statement: 与单独暴露于镉的鱼相比，额外给予褪黑素的鱼体内镉的积累量较低。
text_zh: 与单独暴露于镉的鱼相比，额外给予褪黑素的鱼体内镉的积累量较低。
text_en: Compared to fish exposed to cadmium alone, fish additionally given melatonin had lower accumulation of cadmium in their bodies.

quote: The present findings imply that melatonin co-treatment can effectively protect the fish against the toxic effects of cadmium on endogenous antioxidant status in hepatopancreas tissues and variations in metal concentration, such as Zn, Cu, and Fe.
statement: 研究结果表明，褪黑素联合处理能有效保护鱼类免受镉对肝胰腺组织内源性抗氧化状态及金属浓度（如锌、铜、铁）变化的毒性影响。
text_zh: 研究结果表明，褪黑素联合处理能有效保护鱼类免受镉对肝胰腺组织内源性抗氧化状态及金属浓度（如锌、铜、铁）变化的毒性影响。
text_en: The results indicate that melatonin co-treatment effectively protects fish from the toxic effects of cadmium on the endogenous antioxidant status and changes in metal concentrations (such as zinc, copper, and iron) in hepatopancreas tissue.

quote: The number of leukocytes in the blood of fish of group III was, on average, 3.9*1010 / l and slightly differed from the established for fish fed for a long time with probiotic-containing feed.
statement: Группа III (пробиотик + бисфенол) имела количество лейкоцитов в среднем 3.9*10^10/л, что незначительно отличалось от показателя у рыб, длительно получавших корм с пробиотиками.
text_en: Группа III (пробиотик + бисфенол) имела количество лейкоцитов в среднем 3.9*10^10/л, что незначительно отличалось от показателя у рыб, длительно получавших корм с пробиотиками.

quote: Obviously, this indicates the dominant contribution to the activation of leukocytopoiesis of the appearance of probiotics in the feed ration
statement: Наличие пробиотиков в рационе является доминирующим фактором активации лейкоцитопоэза.
text_en: Наличие пробиотиков в рационе является доминирующим фактором активации лейкоцитопоэза.

quote: We registered an increase in the phagocytic index in fish of the III group (Fig. 3, B). For example, if in the control group it was, on average, 35%, then in the III group of fish it was equal to 60%.
statement: У рыб группы III (пробиотик + бисфенол) фагоцитарный индекс увеличился до 60% по сравнению со средним значением 35% в контрольной группе.
text_en: У рыб группы III (пробиотик + бисфенол) фагоцитарный индекс увеличился до 60% по сравнению со средним значением 35% в контрольной группе.
intervention_record: 益生菌饲料后双酚暴露

quote: On the other hand, there was a tendency to decrease the phagocytic index in fish of the II group - up to 32% on average.
statement: В группе II наблюдалась тенденция к снижению фагоцитарного индекса до среднего значения 32%.
text_en: В группе II наблюдалась тенденция к снижению фагоцитарного индекса до среднего значения 32%.

quote: The highest value of the phagocytic number was noted for animals of the control group (Fig. 3, C).
statement: Наибольшее значение фагоцитарного числа было зафиксировано у животных контрольной группы.
text_en: Наибольшее значение фагоцитарного числа было зафиксировано у животных контрольной группы.

quote: For the other two groups that were exposed to short-term toxic effects of bisphenol, a slight decrease in the level of phagocytic number was shown, and it was significant only in the case of the study of fish that were fed with feed without probiotics.
statement: У двух групп, подвергнутых кратковременному токсическому воздействию бисфенола, наблюдалось небольшое снижение уровня фагоцитарного числа, которое было значимым только у рыб, получавших корм без пробиотиков.
text_en: У двух групп, подвергнутых кратковременному токсическому воздействию бисфенола, наблюдалось небольшое снижение уровня фагоцитарного числа, которое было значимым только у рыб, получавших корм без пробиотиков.
